r: This Agreement (Consultancy Agreement) is made this {dateShort}, by and between:
{repName} represents {client} in his capacity as {repTitle} of the company.
Address 1160/15 Al Mosheer Ahmed Ismail, Cairo, Egypt.
Dr. Tarek Sobhy represents Ökoplan for Landscaping in his capacity as CEO

The Company is {companyType} and is seeking to engage the services of the Consultant to provide The Landscape Design of {project} with total area of {area} m2, located in {location}. Based on the available criteria and background information provided by the Company as a foundation for creating the design concept.
The Consultant accepts the Company's appointment and willing to offer her Services in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement
This Agreement is entered into by the Parties for the purpose of regulating the arrangements between them with respect to such appointment.
The following words and expressions shall have the meanings hereby assigned to them:

The Employer is the owner of the project, or any party authorized or representing him, who accepts the Consultant’s proposal and enters into a contract with him for the execution of the works under this Contract.

The Consultant is the consulting firm responsible for the design of the project and is referred to as the Second Party in this Contract, undertaking all or part of the services required under this Contract, including its legal successors and any parties appointed by it to perform the works. For the purpose of this Contract, this refers specifically to
Means the Contract document, its appendices, and all other documents expressly stated therein to form part of the Contract.
Means the works specified and described in this Contract.
Means the date specified for the commencement of the works in accordance with the Contract conditions.
Means the original period specified in the Contract for completion of the works, including any extensions approved by the Consultant and the Employer (if any).
Means all expenses incurred or to be incurred, whether on or off site, including overheads and related expenditures, but excluding any profit.

Means a calendar day when calculating any time period, excluding weekends and official public holidays. If the last day of a period falls on a holiday, the next working day shall be considered the end of that period.
Means written by hand, typewriter, computer, email, or fax.
Means the currency used for payment under this Contract, which is the Egyptian Pound.
Means the amounts specified in this Contract as consideration for the provision of the consultancy services.

If the First Party requires clarification of any provisions, annexes, or conditions of this Contract, the Second Party shall promptly provide such clarification in writing. In the event of any conflict between the Contract documents, the provision contained in the most recent document, or the one appearing later according to the order of precedence, shall prevail and be applied.
Words expressed in the singular shall, where the context so requires, include the plural and vice versa.

The English language shall be the governing language of this Contract. It is the language in which the provisions of this Contract shall be interpreted, and it shall be the official language used in all correspondence related to the execution of this Contract. Arabic may be used alongside English in correspondence and technical documents where necessary. In the event of any discrepancy or conflict between the texts, the English version shall prevail.
The Consultant shall provide the Services described in Annex 1 and any Services necessarily incidental thereto in accordance with this Agreement.

Unless otherwise instructed in writing by the Company, the Consultant must commence the Services and complete the Services no later than the respective dates set out in Annex 1. the Services must be carried out by the Consultant in accordance with the specifications set out in Annex 1, and shall notify the Company of all necessary action to be taken by other parties to secure the implementation of the agreed Services
The Consultant must take all steps necessary to clarify and confirm the Company's requirements for the Services and the design concept

The Consultant must examine the information and documents relating to the Project and subject to this clause 5-2, will be considered as an approval of their sufficiency for the purpose of fulfilling its obligations under this Agreement, if the Consultant is not satisfied, the Consultant must advise The Company immediately in writing requesting the further information, documents or amendments it requires.

The Consultant must perform the Services to meet the requirements of the information and documents provided by the Company including any amendments thereto requested by the Company or requested by the Consultant and accepted in writing by the Company.
The Consultant must co-ordinate its performance of the Services with other Consultants and contractors engaged by the Company.

The Consultant shall do all things necessary so that designs, documents, types of materials and methods of construction proposed or specified by the Consultant or the Company are suitable for their intended purposes as set out in Annex 1 and any information provided by the Company

The Consultant shall in respect of the designs, documents, types of materials and methods of construction comply with internationally recognized codes, Egyptian standards and recommended best practices, while fulfilling all local codes, regulations and the requirements of local Consultants subject to their approval.
The Consultant shall be aware of any relevant cost plan or budget for the Project which is communicated by the Company.
The Consultant shall advise the Company in respect of reasonable alternative designs or methods

If the Company instructs the Consultant to rectify errors or omissions for which the Consultant is responsible found in drawings, specifications or other documents prepared by the Consultant, the Consultant must comply immediately with the instruction and reissue the drawings, specifications or other documents at its own cost.
The Company shall make available to the Consultant at appropriate times information and documents relevant to the Services
The Company shall endeavor to provide the further information, documents or amendments requested by the Consultant promptly so as not to delay the Consultant in the provision of the Services.

The Company may engage a suitably qualified person to review the designs carried out by the Consultant, when requested by the Company, the Consultant must provide to the Company in a timely manner, all relevant information relating to the Consultant's designs in order that the review may be expedited.
Article 8: Contract Value, Fees Breakdown, and Terms of Payment
In consideration of the services to be executed by Consultant, Company shall pay to consultant a fee amounting to
subject to {vat}% value added taxes including site visits and all related taxes and reimbursable expenses to be paid according to the terms of payments detailed in Annex 2
Phases of Execution of the Required Works by “The Consultant”

The consultancy services period starts after the advance payment is received and all required documents are provided, and ends upon completion of the agreed duration, including any approved extensions that might occur because of the following reasons:
If the Client decides to make modifications during the preparation of the shop drawings that require redesigning part or all of the project.
If the Client assigns Ökoplan any tasks or responsibilities not mentioned in Clause Three of this offer.
If any of the consultants delay in providing data, drawings, or documents required to complete the works in accordance with the project schedule.
The duration for the execution of the consultancy services under this Contract is {durText}, excluding review periods.{durTail}
If the Contract extends beyond {reEvalMonths} months, the fees shall be re-evaluated.

It is agreed between the Parties that copyright and ownership in all designs and other information provided or prepared by the Consultant in connection with the Project while in the custody of the Consultant under this Agreement remains the full property and copyright of the Company. The said documents shall be fully available to the Company unless agreed otherwise in writing by the Company.

This Agreement shall enter into force with effect from date of signature and shall continue in force for a period of {termDays} working days not including client reviews and approvals. This contract could be renewed for a similar period/s based on the written mutual agreement of both parties {renewDays} days before expiration to the date by which the Consultant is obliged to successfully render all the services under this Agreement with determining an extra fees agreed by both parties.
Company may terminate this agreement by giving Consultant {noticeText} prior written notice and the Company shall pay any due payment till the date of termination to the Consultant.

The Consultant must keep secret and confidential and must not disclose to a third party without the prior written consent of the Company information , data, specifications , drawings, reports , accounts or other documents and things supplied or made available by the Company to the Consultant or brought into existence by the Consultant in the performance of or for the performance of the Services and must take or cause to be taken such reasonable precautions as may be necessary to maintain secrecy and confidentiality and prevent disclosure , including
Obtaining confidentiality agreements in a form satisfactory to the Company from its employees, agents and subcontractors.
The obligations contained in this Clause will survive the term or termination of this Agreement and will be enforceable at any time at law or in equity

This Agreement may be terminated immediately by either party if the other party commits a breach of this Agreement, and if this breaching party fails to remedy such breach within {breachWords} ({breachDays}) days of receiving written notice of such breach. Termination of this Agreement does not prejudice any other right for remedy of either party in respect of any breach.

Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, both parties shall each be excused for any delay or default in performing any of its respective obligations hereunder if such delay or default is caused by conditions beyond its reasonable control including, but not limited to, acts of God, government restrictions (including, wars, insurrections, shortages of equipment, fuel or labor, destruction of facilities or materials by fire, earthquake, storm or other casualty, judgment or injunction of any court, epidemic, or failure of public utilities or common carrier (a “Force Majeure Event”); provided, however, that the Party suffering such delay or default shall promptly notify the other Party in writing of the reasons for the delay or default.

If such Force Majeure Event continues for longer than {fmWords} ({fmDays}) days, each Party has the right to terminate this Agreement in accordance with (termination article) by providing the other Party with written notice of its intention to terminate; provided, however, the non-affected Party shall no longer be entitled to terminate this Agreement and such notice of termination shall be ineffective, if the affected Party has resumed performance of its obligations hereunder prior to the affected Party’s receipt of such written notice of termination
In the event of such delay, default or termination, each Party shall bear its own losses resulting there from.
This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted pursuant to the Egyptian laws in force.

The Parties execute this Agreement in the spirit of mutual cooperation and good faith. If a dispute should arise between the Parties, either Party shall be entitled to give notice of such dispute to the other Party and thereafter representatives of the Parties shall meet promptly to attempt in good faith to amicably settle such dispute.

Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Consultancy Services Agreement that the Parties are unable to amicably settle themselves shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the rules of Cairo regional center in accordance with these rules by one or more arbitrators appointed and acting in accordance with such rules. The arbitration proceedings shall be held in Egypt, in the Arabic language. The decision of the court of arbitration shall be final and exclusive and the prevailing Party may enter the arbitral award in any court having jurisdiction.

All notifications required to be made in writing under this Agreement will be validly made by registered letter or by personal delivery with acknowledgment or receipt required, addressed to the stipulated domicile of the addressee, as set forth below, or such other address or person as either or the Parties shall designate by notice as herein required. Notice hereunder shall be effective when received.

In the event of the invalidity of any provisions of this Agreement, or if this Agreement containing any gaps, the Parties agree that such invalidity or gap shall not affect the validity of the remaining provisions of this Agreement. The Parties will replace an invalid provision or fill any gap with valid provisions that most closely approximate the purpose and economic effect of the invalid provision or, in case of a gap, the Parties´ presumed intentions
Neither Party shall be entitled to assign its rights and duties under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party.
Any Modifications or amendments to this Agreement shall be valid only if made in writing.

This agreement including its annexes constitutes the entire agreement between the parties in respect of its subject matter and supersedes and cancels any and all previous oral or written agreements, commitments, and understanding between its parties. A subsequent amendment of this contract will have effect only if expressly agreed to in writing by both parties.

For all submittals specified in Annex 1, written approval /rejection or approval with comments needs to be done by the Company and sent to the Consultant within {approvalDays} working days of submittals. If nothing is received by the Consultant the submittals will be deemed approved and the following phases of deliverables will base on them. If any comments / changes are received after the above mentioned period, if any additional services required by the Company, The Consultant and the Company shall set out fees and terms of payment.
Any comments related to quantity, quality, time, and cost after closing any phase should be considered a variation. The Consultant will set fees for it calculated by working hours.
This agreement is made of two copies, one for each party, and by signing this agreement each party is deemed to have received his own copy.
This agreement shall be valid and legally binding for both parties as from the date of signature.
